text: Palmistry sorts hands into four types named after the elements: earth, air, water and fire. The type depends on how broad your palm is and how long your fingers are. Books differ on the details, so take your type as a rough picture of your personality.

shape: a square palm with shorter fingers
text: A square palm with shorter fingers makes an earth hand. You have a practical, steady, hands-on nature, and what you build with patience will last.
fortune: what you build with patience will last

shape: a square palm with longer fingers
temperament: a curious, quick mind and a way with words
text: A square palm with longer fingers makes an air hand. You have a curious, quick mind and a way with words, and conversations and new ideas will open doors for you.
fortune: conversations and new ideas will open doors for you

shape: a long palm with longer fingers
temperament: a sensitive, thoughtful heart with good gut feelings
text: A long palm with longer fingers makes a water hand. You have a sensitive, thoughtful heart with good gut feelings, and you will notice what other people miss.
fortune: you will notice what other people miss

shape: a long palm with shorter fingers
text: A long palm with shorter fingers makes a fire hand. You have an energetic, quick-to-act, enthusiastic nature, and your boldness will start things that other people only dream of.
fortune: your boldness will start things that other people only dream of
